efficientnet_retrospective.scope: Retrospective descriptive reuse; not a new independent holdout.
efficientnet_retrospective.curves: Whole exact-score blocks; steps-pre matches the stored right-endpoint block AURC.
efficientnet_retrospective.target: Errors of the original fixed deterministic two-logit prediction.
efficientnet_retrospective.selection_of_displayed_mlp: Seed 43 is displayed as requested; all three seeds remain in the results table. No claim of preselected best seed.

policy.joint_claim: Prínos pre oba detektory sa posudzuje prienikovo-zjednocovacím pravidlom (intersection-union).
policy.metric: Párový rozdiel blokovej AURC; záporná hodnota zvýhodňuje profil.
policy.multiplicity: Spoločné tvrdenie vyžaduje splnenie oboch vopred určených podmienok; jednotlivé intervaly sú bodové 95 %.
policy.success_rule: Tvrdiť prínos pre oba detektory iba vtedy, ak sú obe horné hranice 95 % intervalov rozdielu pod nulou; vykázať oba výsledky.

public_detectors.caveat: CLIP/OpenFake: LR confidence AURC is lower than full profile; no stored paired full-minus-LR-confidence CI. CLIP JPEG also has lower point AURC than full on OpenFake and CommunityForensics. ResNet full has the lowest AURC among the six displayed methods on all three cohorts.

independent_ablation.intervals: Original pointwise paired group-bootstrap percentile 95% intervals; no recomputation.
independent_ablation.guard: At least 10 matched-error-discordant groups required; DeepShield has 1 and OpenFake has 20.

figure_specification.risk_curve_resampling: None; every exact-score block is included.
